researchThemes.title: School Disaster Safety and Preparedness
researchThemes.body: How schools translate hazard information into workable evacuation plans, and what keeps those plans alive year after year. Recent work operationalises updated tsunami hazard assumptions in school evacuation planning and builds assessment methods for wind and water disasters.
researchThemes.example: Operationalizing Updated Tsunami Hazard Assumptions in School Evacuation Planning (JDR, 2026); Exploring minimum essentials for sustainable school disaster preparedness, Banda Aceh (IJDRR, 2018).

researchThemes.title: Disaster Education and Risk Communication
researchThemes.body: Teacher training, geomorphology and map literacy, and Web GIS tools that let school staff read local risk. The seminar develops and evaluates in-service training programmes, then measures what changes in schools afterwards.
researchThemes.example: Impact evaluation of a school-based disaster education program in a city affected by the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake (IJDRR, 2020); Three-Steps Hazard Map Reading Method Based on Landform (2024).

researchThemes.title: Post-Disaster Educational Recovery
researchThemes.body: What happens to schooling after the event — reopening timelines, the tension between school buildings and evacuation shelters, and the role of external support. Fieldwork spans the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake, the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes and post-Yolanda Tacloban.
researchThemes.example: Challenges and Potentials for "Supporting Supporters" on Education, 2024 Noto Peninsula Earthquake (JDR, 2024); Linking Housing and School Recovery Post-Disaster: Tacloban After Typhoon Yolanda (2016).

researchThemes.title: School–Community Partnerships and Memory
researchThemes.body: Schools as community assets: place-making in resettlement, community-school disaster models, and how disaster memory is transmitted across generations. Includes comparative work on memory sites in Japan, Türkiye and the Philippines, and on women’s leadership in tsunami-affected communities.
researchThemes.example: Schools as Community Assets for Place-making in Post-disaster Resettlement (Routledge, 2023); A Structured Analysis of Disaster Memory Inheritance through the Lens of the Kobe Model (2025).
